units.source_text: 马戏团的阿光姑娘在人群里早已弄得头晕脑涨。

en.t: The circus girl A Guang had already grown dizzy and dazed in the crowd.

units.source_text: 她骑着的马，时不时高高抬起一条腿，这时候，她那脱落了又重新接起来似的手脚才恢复知觉。

en.t: The horse she was riding would now and then lift one leg high, and only then did her hands and feet, as if they had fallen off and been attached again, regain feeling.

units.source_text: 然而，瞳孔的焦点随之又消散，眼前一片模糊了……

en.t: Yet the focus in her pupils would scatter again with it, and everything before her eyes blurred into a haze...

units.source_text: 她的眼帘里，忽然清晰地映现出远方一张农民老大爷的脸。

en.t: Suddenly, inside her eyelids, the face of an old farmer in the distance appeared with sharp clarity.

units.source_text: 一个汉子在她跟前站住，松开了外褂的带子。

en.t: A man stopped in front of her and loosened the sash of his outer jacket.

units.source_text: 她心烦意乱，恍如沉溺在梦幻之中。

en.t: She was agitated and confused, as though she were sinking into a dream.
